items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: Baron, the man that was coming back playing, didn't he ramble, and they was carrying on him, and that was really the last time I could remember my father playing music.

ctx.x: That's what I heard that name, that's what I thought might be in French.

Yeah, Jean Vigne is how they used to call me, because they were mostly like in French, you know, and when they called him, when they hollered at him, he said, I'm going to hit four more licks on this guy, he said, because someday he'll hit four on mine. And that's the last time I could remember of him playing music, you know, that I remember hearing him play. And he was beating the bass drum at the time. Yeah. And after that funeral, in fact, my brother was just older than me, we followed the funeral all the way…
You remember when he died, did they have a band for his funeral too? Oh yeah.
